# IsOS P02 cross-owner fixtures

The four JSON files in this directory are byte-for-byte copies of the MuJoCo package owner's `tests/fixtures/scene_catalog/` at merged commit `d3381130ff43784ee6c7f652888ae1e5aa625fb9`. IsOS treats them as frozen inputs for its own verifier, graph admission and node-set tests. Compare them with that owner commit when the owner contract changes; do not derive expected results from the live sibling checkout at test time.

`target-descriptor.json` declares `catalog_version:"0.1.0"`, two exact scene IDs and SHA-256 values, three device IDs and scene membership. `legacy-descriptor.json` has neither discriminator nor target metadata. `expected-contribution.json` identifies the contributed process type, seven-node `0.1.0` draft set and generic EOS types. `negative-cases.json` fixes the direct and graph-time `{code,path,stage}` tuples and the stale scene-revision HTTP 409 boundary. The descriptor fixture's scene hashes refer to the MuJoCo owner's exact XML; an IsOS unit fixture may stage those bytes from a pinned copy or run the cross-repository integration against the owner commit, never fabricate a matching digest.

Test order: P01 receipt and payload verification first; P02 descriptor shape, scene XML/profile/digest, device map and selected scene membership second; graph revision and owner setup before publication; Run/Restart rechecks before child replacement. When testing a P02 semantic mutation, create the candidate before sealing its P01 receipt. A mutation of an already sealed linked payload must yield `package_changed` or `package_unsafe_path` first; the linked-scene-symlink case is `package_unsafe_path` at `stage:"payload"`, because P01 rejects the symlink while hashing the payload tree. Exact diagnostic pointers use candidate instance IDs, with the fixture's `simulator`, `drive`, and `arm` as concrete examples. A library availability test can use a temporary missing `MUJOCO_ROOT`; the installed integration replay can use the actual MuJoCo 3.16.0 library and must still confirm the simulator's loaded version at readiness.

The current IsOS `tests/package_verification_cli.py` imports MuJoCo's live `tools/node_contributions.py` and appends a synthetic `@v0.1` process. The P02 owner now already contributes that process, so the old cross-repository replay produces a duplicate type. The implementation slice must make the P01 fixture self-contained or use the exact owner contribution without appending a duplicate, then rerun it against the current MuJoCo master. This test repair must not relax duplicate-contribution admission.
